problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{3}{4(x-1)}?$

feedback.problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{1}{4x}-1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To plot $y=\frac{1}{4x}-1,$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/a32495fcca947d01cf8d3218fc5cfc0cce083a34e6fb6b629d92ba9e47039a6e.png)

- Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{1}{4}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{1}{4x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/027b68fffd1555cc1735fc53a634684b019d396fd48bf7df9d430377ba56df21.png)

- Translate it by $1$ units down to get the graph of $y=\frac{1}{4x}-1.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/e1777e170fe23faa53a53a743ef9a6135451b2ed1b11762b146627790a6aacf8.png)
